status_note: 3d-model-pipeline stage 7a (pilot 2026-10-14): UE import of the Ancient Leshen look-dev run 20261014-h2-lookdev-r2 (profile ancient-leshen-h2-lookdev/2: generic h2_bake H2 figure of the bake run 20261014-h2-bake-r2 + UV1 in metres, MatID, Edge, graded BC/ORM; TeamAccent ribbon on the three crows 6.04 % of the figure, profile ancient-leshen-h2-lookdev-teamaccent-r2) through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt (normaliser h2-lookdev/1) onto the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/AncientLeshen/Rig/SK_AncientLeshen_Skeleton. No weapon (WEAPON_HAND none, rig-contract AncientLeshen weapon_bone null): 16 bones, socket Weapon on hand.R (the claws, WEAPON_SOCKET_BONE of the asset card). MI of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (UseTeamAccent, UseUV1Metres) with the TeamAccent mask and the look-dev LUT as is (UE look-dev iteration 0); base on M_UM_BaseMarker. Teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision 'accents + ring'). At most 'technically imported'; art acceptance of the model by delegation (stage 4 r2 pass pair 8.1, evidence/acceptance/20261014-r2/final.json).
